# 信息型内容被AI概览取代后的流量下滑

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-09-17 17:34（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2100518652139254224
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

AI 出现后，很多网站都发生了这种情况。

人们开始围绕信息型查询大量发布内容，但用户基本已经不再搜索这些问题，或者流量直接被 AI Overviews 吃掉了。

它们的 SEO 起初缓慢下滑，随后突然全面下跌，因为那些让网站维持活力的信号消失了。

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HSaJ__UWgAAAbEv.jpg>)

---

## 英文原文

This is what happened to many sites when AI came out.

Ppl started publishing a massive amount of informational queries, that basically people are not searching for anymore or they are just eaten by the AI Overviews.

Their SEO dropped slowly at the beginning, then all at once because the signals that kept their sites alive died.
